entry.title: Bitcoin Core 32.0rc2 is now available
entry.summary:
The latest release candidate for Bitcoin Core, version 32.0rc2, is now available for download. This version signifies a major update, and interested users can access the binaries from [Bitcoin Core's official site](https://bitcoincore.org/bin/bitcoin-core-32.0/test.rc2/). Additionally, the source code for this release has been published and can be reviewed at the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/tree/v32.0rc2).
For those looking to understand more about the changes and updates included in this release, preliminary release notes have been prepared and are accessible [here](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/bitcoin-devwiki/wiki/32.0-Release-Notes-Draft). There is also a comprehensive testing guide available for those who wish to contribute to the testing phase; this guide provides detailed instructions and can be found [here](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/bitcoin-devwiki/wiki/32.0-Release-Candidate-Testing-Guide).
Community feedback and reports on any issues encountered with this release candidate are crucial and highly encouraged. Contributors and users can submit their comments or report problems through the dedicated GitHub issue page, located [here](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/36315). Once the testing phase concludes without significant issues, this candidate will officially become version 32.0.
